title: The Thing — How One Blood Test Turns Everyone Into a Suspect
central_question: Why does a simple test become one of the most terrifying scenes in horror cinema?
core_thesis: The blood test is designed to identify the alien, but the real psychological horror is what happens to a group when nobody can trust the person standing next to them. When an organism can imitate anyone with microscopic perfection, ordinary human interaction becomes a lethal threat and people must prove their humanity before anyone will trust them.
